title: Styleguide
subtitle: Tokens and components as they ship in the admin

buttons.title: Buttons
buttons.body: One primary action per view. Destructive actions are tinted, not filled.
buttons.label: Save draft

sizes.title: Sizes and icons
sizes.body: The default height follows the density token.

fields.title: Fields
fields.body: Inputs carry a 3:1 boundary; errors add a destructive ring and a message.

toggles.title: Toggles
toggles.body: Pressed state for formatting; a segmented control for views.

form.title: A form
form.body: Labels above fields, help text below, mono for identifiers.
form.excerptValue: A first post on a fresh FerriteCMS site.
form.invalidHelp: Use lowercase letters, digits and hyphens only.
form.commentsHelp: Readers can reply below the post.
form.sticky: Pin to the top of the blog

tabs.title: Tabs
tabs.body: Pills for switching views, a line for page sections.
tabs.panel: Tab panels hold the view's content.

colour.title: Colour
colour.lead: Cool graphite neutrals and one accent, ember. Every text pair is checked at 4.5:1 and every boundary at 3:1, in both modes, by the token gate.

type.title: Typography
type.lead: Inter Variable for the interface, with optical sizing, and Geist Mono for identifiers. Nine sizes and nothing in between.

layout.title: Space and elevation
layout.lead: A 4 px grid, four radii, three elevations, and two densities that resize controls, rows and page padding.

motion.title: Motion
motion.lead: Short, meaningful transitions: overlays, list changes, route changes, the save indicator. Nothing loops and nothing travels far.

controls.title: Controls
controls.lead: Buttons and form fields in every state. Hover and focus are forced here so they can be compared side by side.

display.title: Display
display.lead: Status, badges, the save indicator, times, shortcuts, avatars, skeletons, toasts and cards.

navigation.title: Navigation
navigation.lead: The sidebar, breadcrumbs and the command palette's list.

overlays.title: Overlays
overlays.lead: Dialogs, sheets, menus, popovers, tooltips and the date picker. Open each one to see it.

patterns.title: Patterns
patterns.lead: The kit every screen is built from: the page header, metric tiles and the empty, error and permission states.

data.title: Data table
data.lead: Lists with selection, keyboard movement, a sticky header and actions on hover, plus their loading and empty states.

charts.title: Charts
charts.lead: Five series on the chart tokens, told apart by dash pattern as well as colour, and sparklines for tiles.

surface.title: Surfaces and text
surface.body: Backgrounds, text, borders and the input boundary. shadcn's accent is the hover surface, not the brand colour.

brand.title: Ember
brand.body: The one accent: primary actions, links, the focus ring and selection.

semantic.title: Semantic
semantic.body: Destructive, success, warning and info. Always paired with an icon or a label.

status.title: Content status
status.body: One colour per lifecycle status, shown as a dot plus a label.

chart.title: Chart series
chart.body: Five series colours, each at least 3:1 on background and card.

sidebar.title: Sidebar
sidebar.body: Derived from card and muted, so the sidebar follows the theme.

pairs.title: Contrast pairs
pairs.body: Computed from tokens.css in this page. The bold column is the mode on screen.

scale.title: Scale
scale.body: Size and line height in px. Body text is 14/20.

type.inter: The interface face. Headings use 600 with tight tracking; optical sizing picks the display cut at large sizes.
type.tabular: tabular figures in tables and tiles
type.mono: Ids, slugs, versions and hashes, at 13 px.

elevation.title: Elevation
elevation.dark: In dark mode shadows are off: a 1 px border and a lighter card carry elevation.

density.title: Density
density.body: Switch density in the header to see controls, rows and padding change. Touch screens keep 44 px targets.

durations.title: Durations
durations.body: Page transitions stay at or under 200 ms.

motion.playHint: Each bar fills over its own duration.

easing.title: Easing
easing.body: Enter with ease-out; move between resting states with ease-in-out.

reduced.body: With reduced motion, every duration token is 0 ms, keyframe animations end at once and Motion drops movement, keeping only fades.

status.title: Status badge
status.body: A dot plus a label; drafts have a hollow dot.

save.title: Save state
save.body: Announced politely to screen readers; the visible label crossfades.

time.title: Relative time
time.body: Relative in the text, absolute on hover (title) and in the markup.

keys.title: Shortcuts
keys.body: Keycaps follow the platform: ⌘ on Apple devices, Ctrl elsewhere.

avatars.title: Avatars
avatars.body: Initials on muted; a group overlaps.

skeleton.title: Skeleton
skeleton.body: Shaped like the content it stands in for.

toasts.title: Toasts
toasts.body: Bottom right; undo instead of confirm.
toasts.busy: The server is busy. Try again in a moment.

card.title: Cards
card.body: A border and the card surface; shadows only in light mode.
card.smallBody: A scroll area keeps long lists inside the card.

sidebar.title: Sidebar
sidebar.body: Active item on muted; counts in tabular figures.

breadcrumb.title: Breadcrumb
breadcrumb.body: Collapses the middle when the path is long.

command.title: Command list
command.body: The palette's list, inline. Type to filter.

triggers.title: Overlays
triggers.body: Each opens over a scrim; Escape closes, focus returns to the trigger.

dialog.title: Schedule post
dialog.body: It goes live at the time you pick, in the site's time zone.

alert.title: Delete this post for good?
alert.body: This can't be undone. Trash keeps posts for 30 days instead.

sheet.title: Post settings
sheet.body: Settings slide in from the side so the editor stays in view.

popover.title: Visibility
popover.body: Public posts appear on the site and in feeds.

calendar.title: Date picker
calendar.body: For scheduling; today and the selection are marked.

header.title: Page header
header.body: Title, description, actions (one primary) and tabs.
header.description: Everything published on the blog, and what's on the way.

metrics.title: Metric tiles
metrics.body: The number is text; the change is spoken; the sparkline only illustrates.

empty.title: Empty
empty.body: What the screen is for and the way in.
empty.heading: No posts yet
empty.text: Posts you write show up here, drafts included.

error.title: Error
error.body: The server's message, then a retry.

forbidden.title: No access
forbidden.body: When the server refuses the screen for this role.

editorBar.title: Editor bar
editorBar.body: Status and save state on the left, one primary action on the right.

table.title: Posts
table.body: Click a row, or move with the keyboard:

loading.title: Loading
loading.body: Skeleton rows at the real row height.

empty.title: Empty
empty.body: The table keeps its header; the body explains.

samples.p1: Shipping a CMS as one binary
samples.p3: Importing a WordPress export without the PHP

lines.title: Five series
lines.body: Daily activity over two weeks. Hover for values.

spark.title: Sparklines
spark.body: Decorative and hidden from assistive technology; the value sits next to them in text.
